items.summary: # Accessibility Coding Guidelines This guide provides actionable DOs and DON'Ts for AI coding agents to ensure web applications are accessible to all users, including those using assistive technologies. Keep these principles in mind throughout: - **Accessibility is the minimum, not the ceiling.** Conformance to standards is the floor; aim for genuine usability. - **Patterns are use-case specific.** No checklist replaces real testing  -  including testing with disabled users  -  to confirm a given implementation is actually accessible in context. Content Navigability and Structure ### Actionable Guidelines #### DOs - **Place all content within landmarks**: Wrap the page in `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<aside>`, and `<footer>` so assistive-tech users can jump between regions. - **Structure main content with headings**: Use `<h1>` - `<h6>` sequentially (no jumping `<h1>` → `<h4>`) so screen-reader users get a navigable outline. - **Use lists for repeated, contiguous content**: `<ul>`/`<ol>` give assistive tech a count up front and let users skip the entire group.

items.summary: The extension-openai skill is the mandatory recipe for every Caffeine AI build that calls OpenAI for ChatGPT, GPT-4o, LLMs, chatbots, or embeddings. The only supported path is the openai-client mops package with canister-side API-key bearer storage. Hand-rolling ic.http_request to api.openai.com is a forbidden anti-pattern because it leaks bearer tokens across replicated outcalls, multiplies billing impact, bypasses typed bindings, and forces hand-rolled JSON in Motoko. Load this skill before writing code touching api.openai.com when specs mention GPT or embeddings. Three key variants exist: per-user keys keyed by Principal as default, admin-key when the operator funds usage, and fully anonymous only when specs explicitly omit login. Every variant requires Config with is_replicated set to false for security, billing, and determinism. The openai-client package ships ChatApi, EmbeddingsApi, ImagesApi, and additional modules from OpenAPI spec 2.3.0. Per-user and admin-key variants require extension-authorization for Internet Identity login. Frontend must ship settings UI to paste keys and never expose getApiKey endpoints that return bearer secrets.
highlights: openai-client mops package is the only supported OpenAI integration path.
Config must set is_replicated to false to prevent bearer leaks and 13x billing.
Per-user, admin-key, and fully anonymous API key storage variants documented.
